name: robot_grasp
description: Manipulation failures typed so the failure names the next action: look again, move, or regrip.

verdicts.note: perception cannot see it -> move the camera / change viewpoint

remedy.note: the remedy is another viewpoint, i.e. more observation, not more force

verdicts.note: kinematics cannot get there -> reposition the base
contact made and lost -> try another grasp pose

remedy.note: a new grasp candidate is content; propose -> quarantine -> trial

verdicts.note: the path, not the grasp, is the problem
a hardware capacity, not a software gap

remedy.note: hardware limits are the robot's N_ARMS — design decisions, not knobs

fixtures.evidence: pick aborted: target 'cup_3' not detected, occluded by box_1 from current viewpoint

fixtures.name: too far
